content:
**The Slasher: Masked Truth** is a main quest in *Fallout 76*. It will be implemented in the upcoming fall 2026 update. It is the first of four quests associated with The Slasher, a cycle of limited-time seasonal content.

This quest is only available for a limited-time, when The Slasher seasonal content is active. It is associated with "Phase 1" of the seasonal content, as tracked by The Slasher overarching side quest.

Masked Truth is started automatically once The Slasher seasonal content begins, as part of "Phase 1." The first objective is to listen to the breaking news radio broadcast, narrated by Remington Goodwin. Remington is part of a group investigating the presence of the Pint-Sized Phantoms, a cult worshiping the killer clown legend of the Pint-Sized Slasher. In his breaking news broadcast, Remington reports that various corpses have been found in an "unnatural and tasteless manner," with the Pint-Sized Phantoms being responsible for the killings. After the broadcast ends, the "breaking news" radio station is replaced with the Debunker Radio, and the holotape broadcast recording: breaking news is added to the player character's inventory.

The quest prompts the player to find masked corpses at "cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds." For a list of all 108 locations, see here. The player must find ten of these corpses and interact with the masks on their heads to collect them. Upon collecting one's first mask, a message box appears, stating that a piece of paper has dropped from the mask. This will be article clipping #1. As the player progresses in finding ten masks as required by the quest, they will retrieve more notes. Article clippings #2, #3, and #4 are given after collecting one's third, fifth, and seventh mask, respectively. Hostile Pint-Sized Phantoms may also appear at given locations with masked corpses.

Upon collecting a tenth and final mask required by the quest, the player is given the note A page torn from a children's book. Read it to find a set of directions at the bottom of the page. These directions (and the quest itself) point to an unmarked neighborhood east of the Charleston Fire Department. Head to a home that has a doghouse behind it. Inside the kennel is a meat pile with the note We're coming for you. Reading this note completes the quest, though the player can continue to collect other, unfound masks placed throughout the world for extra rewards through challenges.

In addition to the ten masks required to complete this quest, there are many more to be found throughout Appalachia. Challenges are active during the seasonal content, in which the player must collect increasing amounts of masks to earn unique rewards.

Progression of each challenge does not carry over into the next challenge, which starts the count over. This makes the total number of masks required to complete all challenges over 90; there are 108 locations in total.

The masks retrieved during this quest do not actually act as items added to the player character's inventory, and are instead simple activators on the corpses. The player only needs to interact with the mask on the corpse once (which will remove the mask from the corpse) for it to count as having collected a mask.

 As of the Public Test Server, collecting a mask as the last mask needed for a challenge will effectively cause the mask to count twice: once as the final mask for the existing challenge, and again as the first mask for the next challenge. This can lead to a slightly inaccurate count of how many masks have been collected by the player in the challenge menu, even when taking into consideration the progression from challenge to challenge.
